articles.title: Palo Alto Networks buys Console to boost agentic security
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks acquired AI-native ITSM and automation startup Console to expand the agentic capabilities of its Cortex platform. Console connects to identity systems, SaaS apps, and security tools, letting AI agents gather context, execute workflows, and document actions - another sign that IT automation and security operations are increasingly converging.

articles.title: Google Meet hardware dropping ChromeOS for Android
articles.summary: Google is transitioning new Google Meet room hardware from ChromeOS to Android, opening the door to more device types and hardware that can potentially support multiple conferencing platforms. Existing ChromeOS-based Meet hardware will continue receiving support, with newer devices covered through September 2030.

articles.title: Q&A: Serval CEO describes building an ‘AI-native' alternative to ServiceNow
articles.summary: Serval argues that AI-native ITSM can make automating a repetitive support task faster than handling the ticket manually, using natural language to generate code-based workflows. The bigger argument is architectural: legacy ITSM vendors can add agents, but still have to contend with years of accumulated workflows, custom tables, and configuration that newer platforms were built without.

articles.title: J-Space: The Logs AI Security Has Never Had
articles.summary: Anthropic researchers reportedly found a small internal workspace in Claude, called the J-space, whose activity can reveal concepts related to the model's reasoning before they appear in its output. Exposing this telemetry would give security teams a third detection layer for AI agents, while acknowledging that the J-lens used to read it is imperfect and currently unavailable to enterprises.

articles.title: Who gets to decide? The CIO and the new architecture of enterprise authority
articles.summary: As AI shifts from recommending actions to actually executing them, traditional technology governance based on security, reliability, and architecture is no longer enough. CIOs increasingly need to define what authority automated systems can exercise, under what conditions, and with what accountability.

articles.title: Microsoft Intune Now Lets Admins Target Devices Based on Specific OS Versions
articles.summary: Microsoft's Intune 2608 release adds generally available OS-version assignment filters, giving admins finer control over staged app and policy deployments. It also introduces unattended Remote Help for Windows devices and a redesigned device-management experience.

articles.title: Introducing Azure Multicloud Interconnect for AWS
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced a collaboration with Amazon Web Services to simplify private networking between Microsoft Azure and AWS. The solution combines Azure Multicloud Interconnect with AWS Interconnect, enabling customers to provision high-performance connectivity through an integrated, cloud-native experience built on open API specifications.

articles.title: Commission designates ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox under Digital Services Act
articles.summary: The European Commission designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act, while Reddit and Roblox were classified as Very Large Online Platforms. The companies now have four months to comply with additional obligations around systemic risk assessments, mitigation, transparency, and independent audits.

articles.title: Citrix acquires Numecent to modernize Windows application delivery at scale
articles.summary: Citrix has acquired Numecent, whose Cloudpaging technology packages Windows apps into isolated containers that can be streamed to endpoints without modifying the underlying OS image. Citrix says the approach can simplify app packaging, reduce image sprawl, and make legacy applications easier to manage across physical desktops, DaaS, Windows 365, and Azure Virtual Desktop.

articles.title: CrowdStrike and Google Announce the Falcon Platform on Google Cloud
articles.summary: The cloud deployment is intended to help organizations control where sensitive data is processed and stored while addressing security complexity across multi-cloud and AI environments.

articles.title: Add co-presenters in Google Meet with one click
articles.summary: Gemini can now detect when another participant needs presentation control and suggest adding them as a co-presenter directly inside Meet.

articles.title: Redesigned Microsoft 365 Setup experience now rolling out for IT admins
articles.summary: Microsoft is centralizing deployment progress, licensing, recommended actions, and setup guidance into a revamped M365 admin dashboard.
